players.bio: Abdoullah Mustapha Ba (born 31 July 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in France, he represents the Mauritania national team.

Ajibola Joshua Odunayo Afolarin Alese (born 17 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Premier League club Sunderland. A product of West Ham United's academy, he made his professional debut with the club in 2020. Following loan spells at Accrington Stanley and Cambridge United, Alese joined Sunderland in 2022.
Alan James Browne (born 15 April 1995) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Brian Ebenezer Adjei Brobbey is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team. Born in the Netherlands, Brobbey is of Ghanaian descent. Brobbey represented the Netherlands U17 at both the 2018 and 2019 editions of the UEFA European Under-17 Championship, winning both competitions respectively.
Chemsdine Talbi (born 9 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Christopher John Rigg (born 18 June 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland.
Daniel George Ballard (born 22 September 1999) is a professional footballer who plays for Sunderland as a defender. Born in England, he represents Northern Ireland at international level.
Dayann Methalie (or Méthalie; born 15 February 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Sunderland.

Enzo Jérémy Le Fée (born 3 February 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland. Le Fée began his football career in the youth academy of Kéryado, before moving to the youth academy of FC Lorient at the age of 8. On 13 November 2018, he signed his first professional contract with Lorient.

Granit Xhaka is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and captains the Switzerland national team. Xhaka began his career at hometown club Basel, winning the Swiss Super League in each of his first two seasons.
Mouhamadou Habib Diarra (born 3 January 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and the Senegal national team.
Jocelin Ta Bi (born 9 February 2005) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Sunderland.

Kevin Danso (born 19 September 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Sunderland, on loan from Tottenham. Formerly a youth international at various levels from under-15 to under-21, he made his debut for the Austria national football team in 2017.
Luke Terry O'Nien (born 21 November 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or defender for Premier League club Sunderland.
Melker Åke Ellborg (born 22 May 2003) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland.
Nilson David Angulo Ramírez (born 19 June 2003) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a winger or wide midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and the Ecuador national team.

Noah Junior Sadiki (born 17 December 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back, centre-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he represents the DR Congo national team.
Nordi Mukiele Mulere is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Premier League club Sunderland.

Omar Federico Alderete Fernández is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Sunderland and the Paraguay national team. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back.
Régis Le Bris (born 6 December 1975) is a French football manager and former footballer who is currently the head coach of EFL Championship club Sunderland.

Reinildo Isnard Mandava (born 21 January 1994), also known mononymously as Reinildo, is a Mozambican professional footballer who plays as a left back for Premier League club Sunderland and the Mozambique national team.
Robin Gerardus Petrus Roefs (born 17 January 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.
Romaine Lee Mundle (born 24 April 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Sunderland.

Simon William Moore (born 19 May 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland. Club career Early career Born in Sandown on the Isle of Wight, Moore started at Brading Town, before signing for the academy of Premier League side Southampton. Moore said he was released by the club for being too small.

Trai Hume (born 18 March 2002) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Premier League club Sunderland and the Northern Ireland national team. He previously played in the Irish Premiership for Linfield and Ballymena United.
Wilson Isidor (born 27 August 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in France, he represents the Haiti national team.
